bugs.title: "Click to restore sidebar" does nothing when clicked
preconditions: Signed in to the application with the automation account.
stepsToReproduce: 3. Observe that nothing on the page changes.
bugs.expectedResult: Clicking the button navigates, opens something, or changes what is on screen.
bugs.actualResult: After the click the URL is unchanged, no dialog opened, and the page content is byte-identical — the control has no visible effect.

bugs.title: 28 form control(s) have no accessible label on Local Office
preconditions: Signed in to the application with the automation account.
stepsToReproduce: 2. Inspect the form controls listed above and confirm none carries a label association.
bugs.expectedResult: Every form control is named by a <label for>, aria-label or aria-labelledby, so assistive technology can announce it.
bugs.actualResult: 28 control(s) are named only by placeholder text or by nothing at all: input (-1); input (1); input (-1); input (1); input (0)

bugs.title: Interactive elements overlap on Local Office
preconditions: Signed in to the application with the automation account.
bugs.expectedResult: Controls do not sit on top of one another — an overlapped control cannot be clicked reliably.
bugs.actualResult: 1 overlapping pair(s). Worst: button "Click to restore sidebar" over form "1604 - Parker Palm Springs Save DEFAULT " (39% covered).

bugs.title: untranslated i18n key visible on Local Office
preconditions: Signed in to the application with the automation account.
stepsToReproduce: 3. Read the page text and locate: untranslated i18n key: "layout.actions.venueRooms" (1x)
bugs.expectedResult: Every value shown to a user is a resolved, translated, formatted value.
bugs.actualResult: The screen renders untranslated i18n key: "layout.actions.venueRooms" (1x).
